'''Witold Szczypiński''' (born 7 February 1955 in [[Sarzyna]]) – vice-president of the Management Board of [[Grupa Azoty S.A.]], Director General (former Zakłady Azotowe in Tarnowie-Mościcach S.A.).<ref name="one">{{cite web|url=http://tarnow.grupaazoty.com/en/spolka/zarzadzanie/zarzad/5|title=Zarządzanie|publisher=tarnow.grupaazoty.com|language=English|accessdate=2016-06-30}}</ref> Completed the [[Silesian University of Technology]] at the Faculty of Production Management in the scope of industry organisation and management, specialty [[chemical industry]].<ref name="one" />

== Business career ==

He has worked for Zakłady Azotowe in Tarnów-Mościce S.A. since 1979.<ref name="one" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://tarnow.naszemiasto.pl/artykul/azoty-w-tarnowie-maja-dyrektora-generalnego-zostal%20nim,2219598,art,t,id,tm.html|title=Azoty w Tarnowie mają dyrektora generalnego. Został nim Witold Szczypiński|date=April 2014 |publisher=naszemiasto.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sigma-not.pl/publikacja-70901-azoty-tarn%C3%B3w-na-poczatku-xxi-wieku-przemysl-chemiczny-2012-9.html|title=Azoty Tarnów na początku XXI wieku|publisher=simga-not.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref> In 1979–1987 he worked at the positions of: production master, independent process engineer, specialist process engineer in the Synthesis Unit in contemporary Zakłady Azotowe named after [[Felix Dzerzhinsky|F. Dzierżyński]] in [[Tarnów]] (currently, Grupa Azoty S.A.). From 1987 to 1990 he was the manager of the Department of Silicon and Synthesis Unit, in 1991–1999 he worked as the manager of the Synthesis Unit.<ref name="one" /><ref name="two">{{cite web|url=http://blog.grupaazoty.com/2015/04/jak-powstaly-zaklady-w-tarnowie/|title=Jak powstały Zakłady w Tarnowie?|work=Blog Grupa Azoty|date=30 April 2015|publisher=grupaazoty.com|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20|archive-date=2016-08-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160808073831/http://blog.grupaazoty.com/2015/04/jak-powstaly-zaklady-w-tarnowie/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 1997–1999 he represented Zakłady Azotowe in Tarnów-Mościce in the [[Supervisory board|Supervisory Board]] of the Przedsiębiorstwo Innowacyjno-Wdrożeniowe UNISIL Sp. z o.o. In 1999–2001 he performed the function of the director of Plastic Centre and from 2002 to 2007 was the director for technology and development in Zakłady Azotowe in Tarnów-Mościce S.A.<ref name="one" /><ref name="two" /> In 2007–2008 he was a Member of the Management Board of Zakłady in Tarnów.<ref name="two" /> In 2007–2008 he attended the Supervisory Board of Tarnowskie Wodociągi Sp. z o.o. In 2008 he was assigned the representative of the contemporary Zakłady Azotowe in Tarnów-Mościce S.A. in the supervisory board of the Design Office of Zakłady Azotowe "BIPROZAT" Sp. z o.o and then - PKCh Sp. z o.o. (2008–2016), ATT Polymers GmbH (2011–2013) and [[Zakłady Azotowe Kędzierzyn|Grupa Azoty ZAK SA]] (2012–2016).<ref name="one" />

In 2008 he acted as the president of the management board of Zakłady Azotowe in Tarnów-Mościce S.A.<ref name="one" /><ref name="two" /> In June 2008 he was assigned the vice-president of the management board of Grupa Azoty S.A.<ref name="one" /> Since March 2014 he has also performed the function of the General Director of the company Grupa Azoty S.A. seated in [[Tarnów]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gazetakrakowska.pl/artykul/3386769,azoty-tarnow-maja-nowego-dyrektora-generalnego,id,t.html?cookie=12|title=Azoty Tarnów mają nowego dyrektora generalnego|date=April 2014 |publisher=gazetakrakowska.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref> As a member of the management board, he is responsible for, e.g. the integration of the plastic production and organic syntheses and sponsoring activity.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.lifestyle.newseria.pl/komunikaty_pr/sport/poprzeczka_coraz_wyzej,b891192437|title=Poprzeczka coraz wyżej|publisher=lifestyle.newseria.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref>

In 2011–2015 he was the member of the Scientific Board of the Institute of Heavy [[Organic synthesis|Organic Synthesis]] "Blachownia" in [[Kędzierzyn-Koźle]].<ref name="one" /><ref name="SZCZYPIŃSKI WITOLD">{{cite web|url=http://www.wnp.pl/kto-jest-kim/witold-szczypinski,20.html|title=SZCZYPIŃSKI WITOLD|publisher=wnp.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20|archive-date=2015-07-29|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150729063149/http://www.wnp.pl/kto-jest-kim/witold-szczypinski,20.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2013 he was assigned to the Supervisory Board of Grupa Azoty SIARKOPOL.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://siarkopol.grupaazoty.com/pl/spolka/zarzadzanie/rada|title=Rada nadzorcza|publisher=siarkopol.grupaazoty.com|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20|archive-date=2016-08-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160808073841/http://siarkopol.grupaazoty.com/pl/spolka/zarzadzanie/rada|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He is the head of the Supervisory Board of the Polskie Konsocjum Chemiczne Sp. z o.o.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://pkch.grupaazoty.com/index.php?p=spolka&s=zarzadzanie&lang=pl|title=Zarządzanie|publisher=grupaazoty.com|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20|archive-date=2016-08-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160808073844/http://pkch.grupaazoty.com/index.php?p=spolka&s=zarzadzanie&lang=pl|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pkch.co/firma.php?g=6|title=Władze Spółki|publisher=pkch.co|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref>

== Academic career ==

From 2011 to 2015 he performed the function of the member of the Committee of the Chemical and [[Process engineering|Process Engineering]] in the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]]. In 2012–2015 he was the member of the Committee managing the strategical program of scientific research and developmental works "Advanced Technologies of Energy Generation" of the [[National Centre for Research and Development in Poland|National Centre for Research and Development]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ncbir.pl/programy-strategiczne/zaawansowane-technologie-pozyskiwania-energii/komitet-sterujacy/|title=Komitet Sterujący|publisher=ncbir.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.kierunekenergetyka.pl/artykul,16184,grupa-azoty-przekazala-miastu-projekt-systemu-gospodarki-odpadami-i-energetyki.html|title=Grupa Azoty: Projekt gospodarki odpadami|publisher=kierunekenergetyka.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref> From 2007 to 2010 he was the head of the Management Board of the SITPChem Department in Tarnów.<ref name="SZCZYPIŃSKI WITOLD"/>

He is the author or co-author numerous specialist projects: including six under patent protection, concerning the production of [[ammonia]], [[hydrogen]], food [[carbon dioxide]], [[polyoxymethylene]], [[polycrystalline silicon]], catylisers and [[power engineering]] infrastructure.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.hodorowicz.pl/aktualnosci/szczegoly/uniwersytet-jagiellonski-i-grupa-azoty/|title=UNIWERSYTET JAGIELLOŃSKI I GRUPA AZOTY|publisher=hodorowicz.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20|archive-date=2016-01-28|archive-url=https://archive.today/20160128142946/http://www.hodorowicz.pl/aktualnosci/szczegoly/uniwersytet-jagiellonski-i-grupa-azoty/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://przemchem.pl/pl/rada-programowa/|title=Rada Programowa|publisher=przemchem.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref>

== Private life ==

His father - Zbigniew Szczypiński participated in the development of plants in Tarnów in the 1960s and 1970s. of the 20th century. He performed the function of, e.g. the technical director of the factory in Tarnów-Mościce.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dziennikpolski24.pl/artykul/3409851,azoty-czyli-cale-zycie-szczypinskich,id,t.html?cookie=1|title=Azoty, czyli całe życie Szczypińskich|date=22 April 2014 |publisher=dziennikpolski24.pl|language=Polish|accessdate=2016-06-20}}</ref> He is married and has a daughter.
